cultural.vision_reason: Studio postcard showing three Northwest Coast men in regalia; the museum identifies the man on the right (cloth cap with feather) as Coast Salish, making this a documentary photo of Coast Salish dress alongside neighbouring peoples.

physical.summary:
Postcard (black and white and halftone lithographic colour); three Northwest Coast men (Haida, Coast Salish and Tlingit?), two standing one sitting; two wear decorated headdress with carved frontlets, shell, ermine tails and sea lion whiskers (?); the other man (Coast Salish) wears a cloth cap with a feather; they all wear blankets over shirts (one has a chilkat blanket), and blankets around their waists, with leggings and footwear; British Columbia, Canada. 
Printed
